dct_description_sm: Administrative boundaries (Level 1 - States), (Level 2 - Counties including disputed Abyei region) and Undetermined boundary lines. Digitised from Russian Topo maps 200k (1970). Also includes a list of Admin level 3 - Payams. Data source: South Sudan Inter Cluster Information Management Working Group (ICIWG), National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), and MapAction. PCodes and cleaned by MapAction, OCHA and ITOS.
